reason: The text demonstrates multiple instances of leaders and people working together: (1) Jonathan and his armor bearer collaborate seamlessly throughout, with the armor bearer fully supporting Jonathan's plan (לְכָה וְנַעְבְּרָה); (2) When Saul calls out, כָל־ הָעָם אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ (all the people with him) respond and come to battle; (3) The people obey Saul's orders to check who is missing and later follow his instructions regarding sacrifices and religious observance; (4) When pursuing the Philistines, the people affirm Saul's leadership (הַטּוֹב בְּעֵינֶיךָ עֲשֵׂה); (5) The battle itself is executed with coordinated military action. While tensions emerge later (regarding Jonathan's fate), the predominant narrative arc shows functional collaboration between leadership and people in military operations and decision-making.
